fields.statement: The default TMPDIR={run_tmp} comes from one helper in internal/workflow beside EnvPairs, used by every place a run's [env] reaches a process (engine stepEnv, session_run for spawned sessions, shipRunEnv for the watchdog), so steps, arbiter and advisor, cleanup steps and spawned sessions all get it; a TMPDIR key in the workflow's own [env] wins, and the folder is made whenever the env names it
fields.wording: (assumed, would have escalated) chosen by the conductor from the research pass; autonomous run, no owner present

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... ./internal/run/... passes with new tests (beside gotmp_test.go): a workflow whose [env] names no {run_tmp} (and one with no [env] at all) gives its command, wait, agent and cleanup steps TMPDIR = Store.TmpDir(run), the folder exists as each step runs, a step writes a file under $TMPDIR, and after the run ends succeeded and again after it ends failed nothing of it is left under the tmp root; (failure case) a workflow whose [env] sets TMPDIR = "/x" gets TMPDIR=/x and no second TMPDIR pair in the step env; a workflow's other [env] keys and their {run_tmp} filling are unchanged
fields.must_not: Change where {run_tmp} lives (run.TmpDir) or when the engine removes it; add TMPDIR to a workflow's [env] table or to EnvPairs' output as the file's own (workflow describe keeps showing only the file's [env]); touch internal/api
fields.statement: Every process a run's engine starts (command, wait, gate and agent steps, the arbiter and advisor, cleanup steps) gets TMPDIR set to the run's {run_tmp}, made before the step starts, unless the workflow's [env] sets TMPDIR itself, so what it writes under $TMPDIR is removed with {run_tmp} when the run ends

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... -run 'SessionRun|Abandon|ShipRunEnv|Gotmp|RunTmp' passes with new tests: session run --dry-run --json of a session in a run whose workflow has no [env] (and one whose [env] names no {run_tmp}) shows TMPDIR=<run tmp> in env and the folder exists after a real start; abandoning a run whose step wrote a file under that TMPDIR leaves nothing of it (beside run_abandon_gotmp_test.go); (failure case) a workflow with TMPDIR = "/x" in [env] gives the session TMPDIR=/x only; the env key description in internal/workflow/spec.go and docs/custom-workflows.md say TMPDIR defaults to {run_tmp} unless [env] sets it, docs/reference regenerated with rhiza ship generate, and make self-check passes
fields.files: internal/api/session_run.go, internal/api/ship_build.go, internal/api/session_run_tmpdir_test.go, internal/api/run_abandon_gotmp_test.go, internal/workflow/spec.go, docs/custom-workflows.md, docs/reference/workflow-file.md, cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/describe-golden.txtar
fields.must_not: Change the engine (internal/run) or the helper's behaviour from run-steps-default-tmpdir; change where {run_tmp} lives; remove the /tmp/rhiza-projection-* folders (bug 01M7M3JZFW's)
fields.statement: A session a run spawns (rhiza session run for a run's session, such as a conductor's children) and the watchdog's view of a run (shipRunEnv) get the same run env as the run's steps, TMPDIR={run_tmp} included unless [env] sets TMPDIR, with the folder made, and an abandoned run leaves nothing under the tmp root; the [env] docs say so
